name: limits
meaning: The runtime restriction block (0x34 bytes, +0x40..+0x73) built by init 0x4a1113. Update 0x4a0dc0 stores &obj->limits into g_camRestriction 0x6e4594 when active.

name: robot
meaning: Scenaric_FindByClass(0x65 = Robot, &this->robot, 1) at init. If present and it answers msg 0x3681 nonzero, activation tests the Robot's position against the boxes (flag 0x20) instead of the Wolf's (flag 0x10). That msg 0x3681 means 'robot under control' is inferred.
